blocks.text: TOKYO — A woman’s murder allegedly committed by a US Marine in Okinawa is a “heinous crime”, Japan’s premier said on Monday, as the new accusation of violence involving American forces sparked public outrage. Crimes including rapes, assaults, hit-and-run and drunk-driving incidents by US personnel have long sparked protests on the island, which bears a disproportionate burden of hosting about 70 percent of US military facilities in Japan. The new case involves a US Marine stationed on Okinawa who was arrested on suspicion of killing a 39-year-old woman at a hotel in the city of Naha and stealing her wallet, police […]...
